Aggregate ReturnRequest {
    @identity returnId: UUID
    orderId: UUID @required
    customerId: String @required
    items: List<ReturnLine>
    reason: String @required
    status: String @default("REQUESTED")
    requestedAt: DateTime
    inspectedAt: DateTime?
    refundAmount: Money

    invariants {
        "All items must have quantity greater than zero": items.every(item -> item.quantity > 0)
        "Reason must not be empty": reason is not empty
    }

    operations {
        when approving return with inspectedAt:
            require that:
                - status is "REQUESTED"
                - reason is not empty
            then:
                - calculate refundAmount as sum of items.lineRefund
                - set status to "APPROVED"
                - set inspectedAt to now
            emit ReturnApproved with returnId, refundAmount, approvedAt

        when rejecting return with rejectionReason:
            require that:
                - status is "REQUESTED"
                - rejectionReason is not empty
            then:
                - set status to "REJECTED"
            emit ReturnRejected with returnId, rejectionReason, rejectedAt
    }
}

Entity ReturnLine {
    @identity returnLineId: UUID
    productId: String @required
    quantity: Int @min(1)
    condition: String @required
    lineRefund: Money
}
